item: test_an_encrypted_store_is_refused no longer depends on the lock gate's 5 s header cache being fresh
summary: The test patched connect.is_encrypted_file to True, which the lock gate also reads through main_header_state's 5 s cache (src/database/connect.py _HEADER_TTL_S). When the entry had gone stale before the first request (the app boots slowly on a loaded runner) the gate read the patched answer, found the store locked, answered 503 before the route ran, and cached 'encrypted' for the next ten tests: #1588's full test job failed 10 tests in this file (503 vs 400/507/200/429) while the file passed in isolation. The test now also patches main_header_state to the plaintext answer the gate should see, so only the route sees the file as encrypted. Red first: with _HEADER_TTL_S forced to 0 the unfixed file fails on this test; fixed, 69 pass with TTL 0 and with the real 5 s. Not measured: how long the boot took on the failing runner.
